record.original_question: Consider a magnetic flow on a closed surface of genus ≥ 2 and an energy level such that the topological entropy vanishes.

evidence.quote: Consider a magnetic flow on a closed surface of genus ≥ 2 and an energy level such that the topological entropy vanishes.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a closed orientable Riemannian surface of genus at least $2$, and let $\Omega$ be a smooth $2$-form on $M$ (the "magnetic field"). The associated magnetic flow on $TM$ is the Hamiltonian flow of the kinetic energy $H(x,v)=\tfrac12|v|_g^2$ with respect to the twisted symplectic form $\omega_0+\pi^*\Omega$, where $\omega_0$ is the canonical symplectic form on $TM$ and $\pi:TM\to M$ is the projection. Equivalently, magnetic geodesics are the curves $\gamma:\mathbb R\to M$ satisfying
$$\nabla_{\dot\gamma}\dot\gamma = Y(\gamma)\dot\gamma,$$
where $Y:TM\to TM$ is the bundle map defined by $\Omega_x(u,v)=\langle Y_x(u),v\rangle_g$. The flow preserves each energy level $\Sigma_E=\{(x,v)\in TM: \tfrac12|v|_g^2=E\}$ for $E>0$.

Conjecture. Fix an energy level $\Sigma_E$ and assume that the topological entropy of the magnetic flow restricted to $\Sigma_E$ vanishes. Then the magnetic flow on $\Sigma_E$ has no conjugate points, i.e. for every magnetic geodesic $\gamma$ with $(\gamma(0),\dot\gamma(0))\in\Sigma_E$, no nontrivial perpendicular Jacobi field along $\gamma$ vanishes at two distinct times.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is part of a list of open problems on geodesics and magnetic flows. Related results show partial progress (e.g. characterizations of zero topological entropy below Mañé's critical value for area-form magnetic flows on hyperbolic surfaces, and rigidity results when the flow is conjugate-point free), but the implication "vanishing topological entropy on an energy level implies no conjugate points" for general magnetic flows on higher-genus surfaces does not appear to have been established.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems and Questions About Geodesics (Burns–Matveev)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on Riemannian, Finsler, semi-Riemannian and magnetic geodesic flows, including questions on rigidity under vanishing topological entropy.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed among open problems on magnetic geodesic flows.

status_evidence.title: Anosov magnetic flows, critical values and topological entropy
status_evidence.snippet: For closed hyperbolic surfaces with magnetic field given by the area form, topological entropy vanishes iff the field strength is below the critical value.
status_evidence.claim: Related partial results connect zero topological entropy to dynamical/geometric features for special magnetic flows.

status_evidence.title: Positive Topological Entropy for Magnetic Flows on Surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies conditions under which magnetic flows on closed surfaces have positive topological entropy.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the converse direction (perturbations producing positive entropy) but does not resolve the no-conjugate-points conjecture.
